profile.text: Captain of Reserve Op Team A1. She has prior experience working with a Columbian garrison, and has proven herself to be outstanding in combat. After joining Rhodes Island, she had no problem adjusting to her current work. She joined the Operation Planning Group with its original members, Beagle and Kroos, and has worked hard to become its leading Operator.
